items.text: Monument blockers now decay over a 24‑hour period, are immune to fire damage, and have server‑to‑client sync applied.
Master key no longer gets stuck in its animation state when left‑clicked.
Boat building stations can be deployed even when the ocean level is non‑zero or negative.
Unpowered water pumps no longer act as a gravity source pulling nearby objects.
Improved spawning checks for maintainable structures and pipe access points, allowing them to generate on flatter terrain and reducing false‑negative spawns.
General store UI grids now receive proper closure notifications, preventing asset‑bundle reference leaks; prefabs load correctly through nested components.
Client‑side prediction disabled for firecrackers and survey charges to avoid desynchronisation.
HAB armour now correctly forwards damage to its parent hot‑air balloon health pool.
Network update range for critter animals reduced to lower bandwidth usage.
Pipe and roadside decor placements were frequently blocked by terrain checks, causing >80% spawn failures. Added dithering and configurable retry attempts, improving placement success.
Crystal AR entities started without ammo, preventing players from firing. Fixed missing starting ammo and renamed entities for consistency.
Gamepad cursor moved too fast on UI sliders, making precise adjustments difficult. Cursor speed reduced and value snapping added for sliders when using a gamepad.
Holding left trigger further slows gamepad cursor for fine slider control; cursor speed values exposed as convars and added to UI options.

Doors with code locks that have two or fewer authorized users were still counted in door tax calculations, leading to excessive upkeep costs for small player‑run hotels. Now such locks are ignored in tax calculations (configurable via decay.upkeep_lock_min_users).
Industrial crafter would require a restart after a power loss, halting production. Now it remains active without needing a restart.
Monument blockers now sync to clients, have a 24‑hour decay period, and are immune to fire damage.
Code locks with two or fewer authorized users are ignored in door tax calculations, lowering upkeep costs.
HAB armour now transfers damage to its parent hot‑air balloon instead of itself.
AR entities spawn with the correct starting ammo.
Boat building stations can deploy when the ocean level setting is non‑zero or negative, supporting custom ocean levels.
Unpowered water pumps no longer act as gravity sources.
Maintainable prefabs now spawn correctly with relaxed anchor checks, added terrain anchor rings, and dithering with configurable retry logic to reduce pipe and roadside decor placement failures.
Master key animation no longer sticks on left‑click, ensuring proper swipe behavior.
Paintable dialog interactions and brush cursor are disabled while the F1 menu is open.
General store UI grids now receive closure notifications, preventing asset bundle reference leaks.
Network update range for critters reduced to improve performance.
Client prediction disabled for firecrackers and survey charges to prevent missing‑file errors.
Industrial crafter machines retain their active state after a power loss, removing the need for manual restart.

2026-08-27.summary:
### Gameplay & Economy
- Monument blockers now sync to clients, have a 24‑hour decay period, and are immune to fire damage.
- Code locks with two or fewer authorized users are ignored in door tax calculations, lowering upkeep costs.
- HAB armour now transfers damage to its parent hot‑air balloon instead of itself.
- AR entities spawn with the correct starting ammo.

### Building & Infrastructure
- Boat building stations can deploy when the ocean level setting is non‑zero or negative, supporting custom ocean levels.
- Unpowered water pumps no longer act as gravity sources.
- Maintainable prefabs now spawn correctly with relaxed anchor checks, added terrain anchor rings, and dithering with configurable retry logic to reduce pipe and roadside decor placement failures.

### Items & Interaction
- Master key animation no longer sticks on left‑click, ensuring proper swipe behavior.
- Paintable dialog interactions and brush cursor are disabled while the F1 menu is open.
- General store UI grids now receive closure notifications, preventing asset bundle reference leaks.

### Performance & Network
- Network update range for critters reduced to improve performance.
- Client prediction disabled for firecrackers and survey charges to prevent missing‑file errors.

### Crafting & Power
- Industrial crafter machines retain their active state after a power loss, removing the need for manual restart.

items.text: Improved critter movement speed and animation blending; fixed critters hovering above ground.
AI select/move commands now work on multiple animals with offset to avoid stacking; added ai.selectinrange and ai.deselectnpc console variables.
Fixed missing or disconnected navmesh in rooms behind doors, dive sites, and certain monument interiors; corrected scientist corpse collider layer to prevent blocking movement and projectiles.
Rust+ now allows team leaders to kick players from the team or for players to leave the team voluntarily.
Added decay to monument blockers with a 12‑hour grace period, per‑minute damage after, and debug commands; fixed bug that restored blocker health on server restart.
Adjusted monument blocker health: lowered HP for various rigs and silos, making them destroyable with 1 C4 or 5 satchels.
Player boats now persist timeSinceLastUsed, restoring proper decay behavior on daily‑restart servers.
Fixed water pipe spawns at odd angles and ensured gas station loot spawners reset correctly after server restarts.
Prevented looting of clipping player bodies while mounted on submarines; players must exit the submarine to loot.

Blocked moving items into furnace output slots, fixed zero‑amount fertilizer creation loop, corrected loot panel editor offset, fixed title label to "Composter", and added proper cook‑time prediction for composting.
Added Windows Terminal compatibility to the Windows server console, fixing glitchy and unusable output.
Increased crafting cost for the heavy pot helmet from 1 to 2 sheet metal and from 4 to 8 high‑quality metal.
Corrected misleading "Can't be deployed on boats" error message to only appear when placement is actually invalid.
Fixed dynamic loading of sprites in the store's item overlay, ensuring items display correctly.
Made shop tiles clickable by reassigning resource bundles and fixing stale references, improving navigation.
Corrected composting time for items that are both cookable and compostable (e.g., meat) to use the appropriate time per process.
Adjusted composter filter to accept only food items from the updated prefab/item filter setup.
Prevented compostable items that yield no compost from being placed in the composter.
Fixed a bug where empty magazines could drop twice when using third‑person view.

Added a 3‑second hold‑E requirement to equip HAB armor, preventing accidental equips; also enabled armor gib read/write, added equip effect and placeholder sound, and switched door sounds to chainlink.
Improved critter movement with correct speed values, smoother animation blending, and no hovering above ground.
AI selection commands now affect multiple livestock; offset positions prevent NPC stacking.
Scientist corpses placed on ragdoll layer, no longer blocking movement or projectiles.
Navmesh gaps behind doors fixed, restoring access to rooms such as missile silo and ghostship.
World objects spawn correctly: water pipes no longer appear at odd angles and gas station loot spawners persist after server restarts.
Players cannot loot clipping bodies while mounted on submarines; must exit the mount to loot.
Player boats now retain their usage timer, preventing decay on daily restart servers, and error messages for invalid placement are clarified.
Shield mechanics now function correctly during combat.

2026-08-26.summary:
### World & Exploration
- Improved critter movement with correct speed values, smoother animation blending, and no hovering above ground.
- AI selection commands now affect multiple livestock; offset positions prevent NPC stacking.
- Scientist corpses placed on ragdoll layer, no longer blocking movement or projectiles.
- Navmesh gaps behind doors fixed, restoring access to rooms such as missile silo and ghostship.
- World objects spawn correctly: water pipes no longer appear at odd angles and gas station loot spawners persist after server restarts.
- Players cannot loot clipping bodies while mounted on submarines; must exit the mount to loot.
- Player boats now retain their usage timer, preventing decay on daily restart servers, and error messages for invalid placement are clarified.

### Combat & Damage
- Shield mechanics now function correctly during combat.
